newsitem.title: UK: SIA to raise ex-UK air cargo rates Apr 1.
newsitem.headline: SIA to raise ex-UK air cargo rates Apr 1.

text.p: Singapore Airlines is looking at raising air cargo rates on selected routes from the UK to come into effect from April, SIA air cargo manager for the UK and Ireland Barry Gibson said.
SIA is trying to improve yields on its routes and a rate increase is needed as its flights had been flying at over 90 percent capacity, he added.

Over the last few weeks many airlines have announced cargo rate increases mainly between five and 10 percent to come into effect in March and April with the start of summer timetables. (( - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 1 71 542 7706 Fax+5017))
